title: Customer Data Export Timeout — GDPR Subject Access Request Backlog

content.summary: The GDPR Subject Access Request (SAR) data export pipeline on 2024-09-18 timed out due to an unindexed query, causing a 48-hour backlog of 340 customer export requests and a compliance risk against the ICO's 30-day SAR response obligation.

timeline.event: Batch SAR export job begins processing 340 queued requests
Export job times out after 14 minutes (limit 10 minutes); first request fails
DPO notified by automated SAR-delay alert
Engineering team identifies missing composite index on customer_data_exports table
Index created; export pipeline re-run; all 340 requests processed

content.root_cause: A new personalisation field added to the SAR export schema required a JOIN across three tables without a composite index on the primary filter columns (customer_id, export_date). For customers with > 5 years of transaction history, the query execution time exceeded the 10-minute timeout.
contributing_factors: Schema change for SAR export not reviewed by DBA team before deployment
Export timeout not surfaced as a critical failure — failed silently until DPO alert fired
SAR backlog monitoring threshold was 24 hours (compliance risk is at 29 days)

immediate: Create composite index on customer_data_exports(customer_id, export_date)
short_term: Add DBA review gate to all SAR schema changes (JIRA DATA-200)
Surface SAR export failures as P2 alerts (JIRA OPS-2260)
Add SAR backlog monitoring at 4-hour intervals (JIRA DATA-201)
long_term: Introduce pre-computed SAR export cache updated nightly
Automated SAR response time SLA monitoring dashboard
